verdict: Yes. Glad Ful from Jaipur pitched natural high-protein foods on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from three sharks. Protein is one of the biggest trends in Indian food, with most Indians eating less protein than recommended, and products like protein muesli, peanut butter and snacks sell well.
angle: Gym-goers, working professionals and parents are all looking for more protein in everyday food. Claims must be backed by lab tests and follow FSSAI labelling rules. Taste and price per gram of protein decide repeat purchases.
